passives.name: Sand Cannot Be Broken
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Attack of enemies, but reduces Critical Hit Chance to 0. This effect cannot be removed. After attacking, Resurrects (Greater) all slain allies. At the start of the turn, increases duration of buff(s)/debuff(s) on the caster by [Buff_V_licence_week_104] turn(s). When a non-Fire enemy performs an action, removes all debuffs from the caster, and reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by 50%. Does not take Weakness Gauge damage when all allies except for the caster have been killed. Reduces damage taken from non-Fire enemies, and increases damage dealt to them. Increases damage taken from Fire enemies, and reduces damage dealt to them.
